explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/577: a graph on 4k vertices with minimum degree ≥ 2k contains k vertex-disjoint 4-cycles (Erdős–Faudree, proved by Wang). The statement takes G on Fin (4k) with 2k ≤ minDegree and gives k copies of cycleGraph 4 (non-induced subgraph embeddings) with pairwise disjoint vertex images. The k = 0 case is trivially true. Faithful.
